## structural pattern The source emphasizes several ideas:
### 1. agents need curated foundations Agent outputs are only as reliable as the quality and structure of the data underneath them.
### 2. ontology is dynamic, not static The source pushes toward an active ontology model where entities, relations, and updates remain live instead of frozen.

### 3. data quality is a bottleneck Even a strong structural model fails if: - source data is incomplete - authority or reference quality is weak - public data looks complete but is actually thin or broken
### 4. structure can reduce downstream burden If the data layer is better organized, downstream search, response, and cost pressure can drop.
